summary: CVS Group plc, together with its subsidiaries, engages in veterinary practices, online pharmacy, veterinary diagnostic, and retail businesses in the United Kingdom and Australia. It operates through the Veterinary Practices, Laboratories, and Online Retail Business segments. The company is involved in animal veterinary practices and complementary veterinary diagnostic businesses. It also operates Animed Direct, an online retail business that sells prescription and non-prescription medicines, health supplements, pet foods, and pet accessories; pet clubs; and laboratories, as well as an online dispensary. In addition, the company provides veterinary instrumentation supply and property development services. CVS Group plc was founded in 1999 and is based in Diss, the United Kingdom.
